University of Southampton - Great Scholarships 2023 is a scholarship opportunity offered by the University of Southampton in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign to students applying for an M.Sc. degree in Electrochemistry and Battery Technologies. The selected candidates will receive a £10,000 rebate on their course fee.
hold an offer letter of admission for the M.Sc. Electrochemistry and Battery Technologies program
be willing to be ambassadors for UK Higher Education
be willing to promote the value of studying at a UK University and scholarship advocate
The candidates will receive a rebate of £10,000 on their course fee for a one-year master’s program.
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship using the steps listed below -
